risk_findings.title: Earlier ownership documents were not uploaded
risk_findings.reason: No registered transfer deed (sale, gift or partition) was found in the uploaded documents. This does not mean they do not exist.
risk_findings.recommended_verification: Ask the seller for earlier title deeds and get certified copies from the Sub-Registrar. A title search commonly goes back 30 years, and your lawyer can advise on the right period.
